oracle.name: Dataverse Web API (hosted environment)
oracle.scope: Two hosted runs on 2026-11-27 (dc2ca, dc2cb) of a rollup column created through the Web API in one request with the classic designer's Sum text: the stamp of new rows (Calculated, _date the row's createdon) under the default observed setting.
